backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing timetable management with task storage by day, OCR result processing, time-based task completion validation, and current task detection based on system time.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented features including image upload, editable timetable display, time-restricted checkboxes, JSON export, and OCR test data parsing with associated files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend source files describing components, hooks, utilities, and styling for the timetable application.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles defining warm OKLCH color palette (orange, amber, red) for light and dark modes with custom CSS variables for theming.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Digital Timetable App with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component wrapping TimetablePage with ThemeProvider for light/dark mode and Toaster for notifications.
Card component displaying the currently active task with animated pulse effect, warm gradient styling, and task details including time and location.
frontend/src/components/ExportButton.tsx: Button component that exports the weekly timetable data to a downloadable JSON file with success/error toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/TimeRestrictedCh: Checkbox component enforcing time-slot restrictions for task completion, showing lock icon when disabled and providing contextual tooltips based on current time and day.
frontend/src/components/TimetableTable.t: Weekly schedule table component displaying tasks organized by day with time slots, locations, status badges, and time-restricted completion checkboxes.
React component for uploading timetable images with file validation (type, size), preview display, and upload progress tracking using the useTimetableUpload hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that manages the ICP backend actor instance, creating authenticated or anonymous actors based on Internet Identity state and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentTime.ts: Hook that returns the current hour, minute, and day of week, updating every minute to support time-based UI states.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for ICP login/logout, managing auth client creation, identity persistence, and delegation validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useTimetableData.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching weekly schedule and current task data, plus mutations for toggling task completion and marking tasks in progress.
frontend/src/hooks/useTimetableUpload.ts: Hook that handles timetable image upload to the backend, processes OCR from the image, sends results to the backend, and tracks upload progress.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom warm color palette (orange/amber theme) for light and dark modes, plus utility classes for task states (pending, active, completed).
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/TimetablePage.tsx: Main page component that displays the timetable interface including upload section, current task card, weekly schedule table, and export functionality.
frontend/src/utils/jsonExport.ts: Utility function that converts weekly schedule data to JSON format and triggers a browser download of the timetable data.
frontend/src/utils/ocrParser.ts: Exports a predefined timetable array (PREDEFINED_TIMETABLE) containing hardcoded OCRResult objects for a daily routine from 8:30 AM (Wake Up) through various activities across all seven days, using BigInt for time values.
frontend/src/utils/timeValidation.ts: Provides utility functions to check if current time falls within a TimeSlot, format time slots into 12-hour AM/PM strings, and convert DayOfWeek enum to string.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color scheme using OKLCH color space (warm tones, avoiding blue/purple), custom animations, typography, and design tokens for a modern UI with Inter and Lexend fonts.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking implemented features (image upload, OCR extraction, time-restricted checkboxes, editable table, JSON export) and architectural notes about real-time validation and dual output formats for a digital timetable app.
